verdict.rationale: dltHub's orchestration product claims 'lineage-aware pipeline runs', which shows the product tracks lineage between pipelines. Nothing documents a view where the engineer can see which sources, steps and transformations produced each table. Run logging and monitoring are related but do not show lineage. missing for 10: documented lineage visualization or graph, per-table source-to-transformation tracing, column or dataset-level lineage detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I see end-to-end lineage of my datasets — which sources, steps, and transformations produced each table

citations.quote: Schedule lineage-aware pipeline runs with agents, all in Python
